title: Managing Director, Enterprise Quality
text:
We are hiring a Managing Director, Enterprise Quality to join our Enterprise Risk Adjustment, Quality & Affordability team at BCBST!

In this role, reporting to the VP of Enterprise Risk Adjustment, Quality and Affordability, you will provide enterprise leadership and strategic direction for Quality ratings, with accountability for establishing and executing the enterprise Quality strategy and driving measurable performance across key programs and outcomes. You will lead and integrate quality efforts across Medicare, Commercial and Medicaid products, including MA Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, clinical quality, pharmacy, member experience, provider performance, data and analytics. You’ll establish clear governance and accountability, evaluate performance and the effectiveness of interventions, and partner across the organization to remove barriers, align priorities, and drive sustained improvement in enterprise Quality performance.

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring significant healthcare quality leadership experience and a track record of leading at the enterprise level. You’ll be a strong candidate if you have led complex Quality functions and are comfortable operating in a highly visible leadership role that requires influence across multiple areas of the organization.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Own and direct the enterprise Quality strategy, establishing priorities, objectives, and performance expectations across lines of business and key Quality domains, including Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, Appeals, clinical quality, member experience, provider performance, and other priority Quality areas.
* Establish and lead enterprise Quality governance and performance management, ensuring clear accountability among Quality leaders, Measure Champions, and cross-functional stakeholders for achievement of established goals and performance outcomes.
* Monitor enterprise Quality performance and intervention effectiveness, using data and analytics to identify emerging risks, performance gaps, and opportunities; ensure interventions are achieving required results and drive timely corrective action and escalation when performance is off track.
* Lead and integrate Quality efforts across the enterprise, partnering with Clinical Operations, Pharmacy, Provider and Network organizations, Customer Service, Member Experience and Outreach, Risk Adjustment, IT/Data, and other functions to align priorities, resolve cross-functional barriers, and coordinate Quality activities that extend beyond the formal Quality organization.
* Provide strategic oversight for clinical and service quality improvement, regulatory readiness, and accreditation, ensuring Quality programs and practices align with applicable CMS, NCQA, URAC, and other regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Direct enterprise strategies to improve provider Quality performance, including collaboration on provider engagement, value-based care, performance improvement, incentive programs, and other initiatives designed to improve clinical and Quality outcomes.
* Lead, develop, and align Quality leaders and teams, establishing clear expectations and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring the organization has the appropriate expertise, resources, and capabilities to achieve Quality objectives.
* Serve as a leader and advocate for Quality, communicating performance, risks, priorities, and recommendations to executive leadership and other key stakeholders and influencing decisions necessary to advance enterprise Quality outcomes.

**Job Qualifications**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, health sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, required. Equivalent experience is defined as four years of professional work experience in a corporate or healthcare environment.

Experience

* 10 years - Experience in healthcare, health insurance, Quality, performance improvement, or a related field required.
* 5 years - Progressive leadership experience, including responsibility for leading leaders and/or complex, cross-functional teams required.
* Significant experience leading healthcare Quality strategy, performance improvement, or Quality management programs required.
* Experience with healthcare Quality measurement and performance programs, including Medicare Advantage, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, or similar programs required.

Skills/Certifications

* Extensive knowledge of healthcare Quality measurement, performance improvement, and industry practices, including Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, clinical quality, and provider performance.
* Strong knowledge of applicable healthcare regulatory and accreditation requirements, including CMS, NCQA, and URAC.
* Strong strategic planning, analytical, and performance management skills with the ability to translate complex data and performance trends into actionable strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to establish accountability and drive results across complex, cross-functional environments, including areas outside of direct reporting authority.
